# BROTOTO

> BROTOTO is a French independent studio creating accessible mobile games and playful experiences.

The public site is https://brototo.fr/. English is the default language. The home page, games listing and game page also have French versions at the same URL with `?lang=fr`. The privacy policy is currently available in English.

## Pages

- [Home](https://brototo.fr/): studio overview and contact details.
- [Games](https://brototo.fr/games/): current game catalogue.
- [Idle Egg Tycoon](https://brototo.fr/games/idle-egg-tycoon/): a free mobile game about creating monsters from eggs, with gameplay details and screenshots. Coming soon; the site has no public store link yet.
- [Privacy Policy](https://brototo.fr/privacy/): data handling for BROTOTO games and apps.

## About the studio

BROTOTO SAS is based in France. Contact: alexandre@brototo.fr. The site's game catalogue currently contains Idle Egg Tycoon; the home page also links to the separate Couple Arena project.
